summary: Frontend regression + new-flow verification for public form sharing. Verified Share Form dialog on dashboard (QR, URL, copy, native share, print-QR), public /submit route hides back-link and redirects to /thank-you on submit, /thank-you 'Submit Another' button links back to /submit, admin /inspect/new still redirects to /inspect/:id, and both public + admin submissions appear in the dashboard list via GET /api/inspections. No backend changes were tested; only the 3 new flows + admin regression as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: ThankYou.jsx: the 'Close Window' Button has both onClick on the Button (asChild) and onClick on the inner <a>. With asChild, the Button merges props onto the <a>, so onClick is set twice - benign here but confusing; remove the Button-level onClick.

ShareFormDialog.printQr clones #masci-share-qr's outerHTML into a popup; if the dialog is closed before printing it will be missing. Currently fine because printQr is only callable while dialog open, but worth noting.
ShareFormDialog: native share fallback is silent when navigator.share exists but user cancels (catch swallows error). Acceptable.
publicUrl is computed once in useMemo with empty deps - correct since window.location.origin is stable per page load.
NewInspection.jsx now accepts publicMode prop but the component file has grown past 500 lines - consider extracting sections into subcomponents.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed inspections during e2e tests and deleted all of them via DELETE /api/inspections/{id} at the end. No seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature pad requires real page.mouse drag with ~20-25 strokes and steps=3 + small wait_for_timeout(20) between moves; fewer/faster strokes get dropped by signature_pad and submission silently fails validation ('Inspector signature is required' toast). When using wait_for_url after submit on /inspect/new, do NOT use glob '**/inspect/**' (it matches the source /inspect/new); use a regex like re.compile(r'/inspect/(?!new)[^/]+$') or check page.url after a small wait.
rca of the issue: No active product issues. One initial test failure was traced to insufficient signature stroke count (resolved by drawing 24 strokes with steps=3). One reported 'admin_flow=False' was a test-script-only false negative caused by glob '**/inspect/**' matching the starting URL '/inspect/new'; the underlying admin redirect to /inspect/:id worked correctly (confirmed via dashboard listing and DELETE 200 in cleanup).
